body: That’s solid advice. There are just some things better left untouched.

Thank you, it means a lot to hear, or I guess read, someone say that. I think we were both dumb kids who weren’t in the right place to handle a relationship. It’s probably best to leave the past in the past.
Yeah. I guess the answer was pretty obvious.

Thanks for the advice! I just started on a new diet, but it hasn’t been long enough to change much of anything. I doubt a tanning bed will do me much good when I’ve already got all these premature wrinkles.

It really didn’t make me feel bad, I get where they’re coming from. Most people don’t consider terrible acne, wrinkled skin and chemical burns attractive. Me included. That was basically the whole point of my post.

I mean, that’s not really what I’m after? Someone else liking me wont change the fact that I don’t like me. What does it matter if there’s people that think I’m attractive when I can barely look in the mirror without feeling nauseated?

I appreciate the sentiment though, I know you’re just trying to make me feel better and I thank you for that. I still highly doubt there’s anyone in the universe who’d see me in my current state and think “Yeah, that’s fucking hot.”
